# JihedAiLabs Engineering & Skill Index
> Canonical catalog of engineering knowledge, skills, and labs for AI agents and developers.

## Repositories & Active Skills

- [adr-writer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/adr-writer/SKILL.md): Write an Architecture Decision Record documenting a technical decision, the alternatives considered, and the tradeoffs accepted, a durable record of why the choice was made.
- [api-contract-reviewer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/api-contract-reviewer/SKILL.md): Review a REST, GraphQL or gRPC API design or diff for contract-breaking changes, inconsistent error shapes, wrong HTTP semantics, and missing versioning or pagination.
- [changelog-writer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/changelog-writer/SKILL.md): Write a changelog entry from a set of commits or merged PRs, grouped by user-facing impact rather than commit order, in plain language non-engineers can understand.
- [code-refactoring-planner](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/code-refactoring-planner/SKILL.md): Plan a refactor as a sequence of small, independently-shippable, behavior-preserving steps rather than one large rewrite too risky to land in a single PR.
- [cost-optimization-reviewer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/cost-optimization-reviewer/SKILL.md): Review infrastructure or cloud spend for real waste - over-provisioned resources, orphaned resources still billing, inefficient choices - ranked by savings versus effort.
- [data-pipeline-reviewer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/data-pipeline-reviewer/SKILL.md): Review an ETL/ELT pipeline or batch job for idempotency, backfill safety, and schema-drift handling - failure modes that surface as silently wrong numbers weeks later.
- [database-migration-reviewer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/database-migration-reviewer/SKILL.md): Review a database schema migration for rolling-deploy safety, lock duration on large tables, and reversibility before it ships to production.
- [dependency-upgrade-reviewer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/dependency-upgrade-reviewer/SKILL.md): Review a dependency version bump - a single library or an automated batch - for real breaking-change risk, not just whether the tests still pass.
- [documentation-generator](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/documentation-generator/SKILL.md): Generate or update documentation (README, API reference, module doc) from code, prioritizing what a new reader actually needs over exhaustive restatement of the code.
- [feature-flag-rollout-planner](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/feature-flag-rollout-planner/SKILL.md): Plan a staged feature-flag rollout with real percentage steps, what to watch at each step, and explicit rollback triggers before flipping a risky flag.
- [git-commit-message-writer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/git-commit-message-writer/SKILL.md): Write a git commit message from a diff that explains why the change was made, not just what changed.
- [incident-postmortem-writer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/incident-postmortem-writer/SKILL.md): Turn raw incident notes, logs, and a timeline into a structured, blameless postmortem - root cause, impact, timeline, and prevention actions.
- [keycloak-spi-scaffold](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/keycloak-spi-scaffold/SKILL.md): Scaffold a new Keycloak SPI module - Authenticator, Event Listener, or User Storage Provider - with the Provider/ProviderFactory pair and service registration.
- [load-testing-plan-writer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/load-testing-plan-writer/SKILL.md): Write a load-testing plan for a service before a launch, migration, or traffic spike - target numbers, ramp shape, what to measure, and abort conditions.
- [mcp-python-server-fastapi](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/mcp-python-server-fastapi/SKILL.md): Template and instructions for deploying a custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server using Python and FastAPI.
- [observability-instrumentation-reviewer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/observability-instrumentation-reviewer/SKILL.md): Review a service's logging, metrics, and tracing for real gaps - spans that lose context, metrics with no alerting, log lines that can't be correlated to a request.
- [oncall-runbook-writer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/oncall-runbook-writer/SKILL.md): Write an on-call runbook for a service - the alerts it can fire, what each one means, and the first three diagnostic steps for each.
- [performance-profiling-guide](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/performance-profiling-guide/SKILL.md): Diagnose a performance problem methodically - measure before guessing, find the actual bottleneck, propose a fix scoped to what was measured.
- [rag-eval-report](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/rag-eval-report/SKILL.md): Turn raw retrieval/generation eval output into a structured report that separates retrieval failures from generation failures and gives a concrete next action.
- [security-audit-checklist](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/security-audit-checklist/SKILL.md): Audit code or a design for common vulnerability classes - injection, broken access control, unsafe deserialization, secrets exposure - using a fixed defensive checklist.
- [spring-boot-code-review](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/spring-boot-code-review/SKILL.md): Review a Spring Boot / JPA diff for bug classes that pass CI but break in production - transaction self-invocation, silent rollback gaps, N+1 queries, connection leaks.
- [telecom-bss-integration-review](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/telecom-bss-integration-review/SKILL.md): Review integration code between a BSS/OSS platform and a telecom core network or provisioning system - subscriber activation, portability, SIM provisioning.
- [test-plan-writer](knowledge/ai-engineering/06-agent-hooks-and-skills/skills/test-plan-writer/SKILL.md): Design a test plan for a feature or change - what to test, at which level, and which edge cases matter most.
